d:
Ekdam sopht, spanji aur chatapte bina phraee kie hue dahi vare (No-Fry Dahi Vada) ruee jaise sopht dahi vare khane men utne hi svadisht hain jitne paranprik tale hue dahi bare agar aapko Healthy Dahi Vada, Soft Dahi Bhalla aur aasan bhartiy snaiks pasand hain, No Fry Dahi Vada ki ye resipi jarur dekhen.
Ingredients for No Fry Dahi Vada
Mung dal - Moong Dal - 1 cup
Urad dal - Urad Dal - ½ cup
Hari mirch - Green Chilli - 1 tsp
Adrak - Ginger - 2 tsp
Namak - Salt - 2 tsp
Eeno - Eno - 1 tsp
